title: SiriusXM Welcomes Hannah Berner and Paige DeSorbo’s ‘Giggly Squad’ Podcast
summary: The deal also expands the Giggly Squad universe with new original programming coming in 2027.
body_markdown:
Hannah Berner and Paige DeSorbo’s *Giggly Squad* — the hit comedy podcast hosted by the best friends and former *Summer House* stars — is joining SiriusXM.


As part of the new partnership, SiriusXM will exclusively distribute *Giggly Squad* through the SiriusXM Podcast Network and represent the show’s global advertising across audio and video. The deal will also expand the *Giggly Squad* universe with new original programming coming in 2027, with more details to be announced.


### Hannah Berner and Paige DeSorbo Join SiriusXM


“We’re so excited for this next chapter with SiriusXM,” Hannah and Paige said in a joint statement. “ *Giggly Squad* has grown beyond anything we could have imagined and getting to experience that growth with the Gigglers has made it even more special. We can’t wait for what’s next and to keep giggling together.”


What started as an Instagram Live series in 2020 has grown into a top 10 comedy podcast, sold-out live tours spanning 70 cities — including two shows at New York City’s Radio City Music Hall — and the New York Times bestselling book *How to Giggle* .


On *Giggly Squad* *,* Hannah and Paige bring their signature humor to candid conversations about dating, pop culture, fashion, friendship, and the everyday chaos of their lives.


### How to Listen to *Giggly Squad*


New episodes of *Giggly Squad* continue to be available every Tuesday and Friday on the SiriusXM app, YouTube, and everywhere podcasts are available.


Listeners can also hear new episodes ad-free by subscribing to SiriusXM Podcasts+ on Apple Podcasts or by visiting[SiriusXM.com/PodcastsPlus](http://siriusxm.com/PodcastsPlus) to start a free trial.
